successCriteria.description: The `LeavePolicy` entity interface exists at `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts`, extends `BaseEntity` from `../../shared/types/index.ts`, and declares all canonical fields: `id`, `policyName`, `leaveType` (typed as `LeaveType`), `entitlementDays`, `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, `minimumNoticeDays`, `requiresManagerApproval`, `isActive`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.

`IPolicyRepository` interface declares `findById`, `findByLeaveType`, `findActive`, `findActiveByLeaveType`, `create`, and `update` with the exact signatures specified in PLAN.md Phase 2, importing `LeavePolicy` from `./policy.model` and `LeaveType` from `../../shared/types/index.ts`.

`IPolicyService` interface declares `getById`, `getByLeaveType` (returns active policy or null), `getAllActive`, and `validatePolicyExists` (returns policy or throws) with the exact signatures specified in PLAN.md Phase 2.

`PolicyService` implements `IPolicyService`, receives `IPolicyRepository` via constructor injection, and delegates correctly: `getByLeaveType` calls `findActiveByLeaveType`; `validatePolicyExists` calls `findById` and throws an Error if the result is null or `isActive === false`.

Jest unit tests at `tests/unit/modules/policy/policy.service.spec.ts` mock `IPolicyRepository` and cover: `getById` returns policy or null; `getByLeaveType` delegates to `findActiveByLeaveType`; `getAllActive` delegates to `findActive`; `validatePolicyExists` returns policy when found and active; `validatePolicyExists` throws when not found; `validatePolicyExists` throws when policy is inactive.

Barrel file `src/modules/policy/index.ts` re-exports `LeavePolicy`, `IPolicyRepository`, `IPolicyService`, and `PolicyService` as named exports, following the pattern established by `src/modules/uptime/index.ts` and `src/modules/status/index.ts`.

constraints: The `LeavePolicy` entity MUST extend `BaseEntity` from `../../shared/types/index.ts` — this is the binding directive from PLAN.md Phase 2, overriding the Employee module's pattern of declaring its own `id`/`createdAt`/`updatedAt` fields.
All database access goes through `IPolicyRepository` — no inline SQL or ORM calls in `PolicyService` (GP-001).
The `LeaveType` type alias is imported from `../../shared/types/index.ts` — never redefined locally in the policy module.
The `PolicyService` constructor follows the same injection pattern as `EmployeeService`: `constructor(private readonly policyRepository: IPolicyRepository) {}`.
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementation (e.g., Knex/PostgreSQL `PolicyRepository` class) — only the `IPolicyRepository` interface is in scope for Phase 2.

HTTP routes, controllers, or Fastify plugin registration for the policy module — no REST surface is created in Phase 2. The policy module exposes only its service interface for in-process consumption by downstream modules (balance, leave).

Audit logging of policy mutations — audit records for policy create/update operations are deferred to a later phase when the concrete repository is implemented and the audit module (Phase 4) is available.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeavePolicy has exactly one `leaveType` from the `LeaveType` union. The `isActive` boolean governs whether the policy can be used for leave requests — only active policies are returned by `findActive`/`findActiveByLeaveType` and pass `validatePolicyExists`. The `entitlementDays` field is a positive integer that drives balance creation in Phase 3. The `minimumNoticeDays` field, when defined, will be enforced by the leave module at submission time. The `requiresManagerApproval` boolean will gate auto-approval logic in Phase 5.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the repository layer — auth is enforced at the service/route layer in later phases.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null when no active policy exists for the given leaveType — never throws.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the service layer in this phase — auth enforcement is deferred to route guards in Phase 5.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws an Error (not a domain-specific error type) when the policy is not found OR when `isActive === false`. The error message must distinguish between the two cases. This method is a guard used by downstream modules (leave, balance) to assert policy validity before proceeding.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at the service layer in this phase.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns the single active policy for the given leaveType, or null if none exists. Delegates to `findActiveByLeaveType` on the repository. Never throws.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `LeaveType` type alias used in `LeavePolicy.leaveType` and all repository/service method signatures MUST be the exact same type imported from `../../shared/types/index.ts` — the canonical definition at `src/shared/types/index.ts` line 1: `export type LeaveType = 'annual' | 'sick' | 'emergency' | 'unpaid' | 'maternity' | 'paternity'`. No local redefinition, no enum conversion.

The `BaseEntity` interface extended by `LeavePolicy` MUST be the exact interface from `src/shared/types/index.ts` lines 8-12: `{ id: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date }`. The `LeavePolicy` entity must not redeclare `id`, `createdAt`, or `updatedAt` — it inherits them via `extends BaseEntity`.

The test file structure and mocking pattern MUST match the existing `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.service.spec.ts`: use `jest.Mocked<IPolicyRepository>`, a factory function for `LeavePolicy` test fixtures, `beforeEach` to reset mocks, and the same describe/it nesting style.

The barrel export pattern in `src/modules/policy/index.ts` MUST match the existing pattern in `src/modules/uptime/index.ts`: named re-exports of the entity interface, repository interface, service interface, and service class. No default exports.

integrationPoints.why: The balance module will use `IPolicyRepository.findActiveByLeaveType` or `IPolicyService.getByLeaveType` to look up the active policy for a leave type and read `entitlementDays` to initialize a `LeaveBalance` record. It will also call `IPolicyService.validatePolicyExists` as a guard before balance operations.
